subject: Founders Accelerator: custom onboarding sweetener & demo credit proposal
messages:
From: Anna Morales <anna@brightforge.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-21T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Founders accelerator onboarding — ask re: demo credits and sweeteners

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for taking my call today — BrightForge (we're a 10-person start-up in the SparkNine cohort) is lining up vendor credits to make onboarding smoother for our product team. Two asks: 1) a short promo sweetener (one-off credits) to cover demo and evaluation traffic for the first 60 days, and 2) a temporary stacking allowance so we can apply a LaunchPartner voucher on top of any promo you provide.

We typically see spikes when we run hands-on demos for investors and early customers; the extra credits would help us avoid throttling while we ramp. Can you share what exceptions you can make for cohort partners and whether you can do a short-term dedicated discount if we commit to a 6-month reserved plan after pilot?

Attaching our onboarding card and estimated first-month usage.

Best,
Anna
Anna Morales
Head of Ops, BrightForge Labs
[Attachment: BrightForge_onboarding_request.pdf (PDF, 180KB)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Anna Morales <anna@brightforge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-21T18:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Founders accelerator onboarding — ask re: demo credits and sweeteners

Hi Anna — great to meet earlier. Appreciate the context and the usage snapshot. High level proposal we can move quickly on:

- One-time promo sweetener: 50k generator tokens (hosted API) + 10k embedding units, valid for 60 days from activation.
- Demo credits: we can pre-seed an additional 25k dev tokens earmarked for demo/live investor sessions (tagged in billing for visibility).
- Stacking: we can allow a single partner voucher to be applied on top of the sweetener (we'll need the voucher ID to validate).
- Conversion path: if BrightForge converts to a 6-month reserved capacity commitment within the trial window, we can offer a 12% committed discount and roll remaining promo credits into month 1 of the reserved period.

Two asks from our side before we finalize:
1) Confirm the voucher ID you want to stack.
2) Agree to a 90-day usage reporting checkpoint (we'll share token consumption and conversion triggers).

I've attached a short RFQ draft to capture the sweetener terms for legal/accounting. If this looks OK I can loop in Priyom to handle accounting mapping and Ben to sign the approval.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: RFQ_sweetener_draft_20260721.pdf (PDF, 45KB)]

From: Anna Morales <anna@brightforge.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Shah <samir@launchpad.vc>
Date: 2026-07-22T09:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Founders accelerator onboarding — ask re: demo credits and sweeteners

Aditya — thanks, that structure is close to what we need. A couple clarifications:

- Voucher ID for stacking: LP-202607-BF (that is the Launchpad voucher).
- Can demo credits be restricted to specific project IDs (we'd like to avoid using them for unrelated test jobs)?
- Our finance team prefers credits that roll forward only if we execute the reserved commitment within 45 days of activation (can you do 45 days instead of 60 for conversion eligibility?)

If you can accommodate the project-level restriction and the 45-day conversion window, we can confirm today and get legal to sign a minimal MSA addendum.

Best,
Anna

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-22T12:56:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: BrightForge — approval & accounting mapping request (thread)

Folks — forwarding the ask from BrightForge. Key points:
- Proposed sweetener: 50k gen tokens + 10k embeddings (60d initially), plus 25k demo tokens tagged to project IDs.
- Customer asks: stack Launchpad voucher LP-202607-BF; restrict demo credits to project IDs; shorten the conversion eligibility window to 45 days.
- Conversion incentive: 12% off a 6-month reserved commit.

Questions for ops/legal/accounting:
- Priyom: can we map these credits to a promo code bucket that is visible in billing and can accept voucher stacking? Also need guidance on revenue recognition if they convert within 45d vs 60d.
- Laura: legal — is a minimal addendum OK for the 45d change and stacking note? Any red flags?
- Ben: approval requested for the revised terms and to confirm cap/expiry policy.

Quoted for context:
> "If you can accommodate the project-level restriction and the 45-day conversion window, we can confirm today and get legal to sign a minimal MSA addendum."

I think this is a good play — small upfront cost, high chance to convert (BrightForge is demo-ready). Happy to jump on a 15-min call if helpful.

Thanks,
Aditya

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-24T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: BrightForge — approval & accounting mapping request (thread)

Aditya — good alignment. Approve the sweetener with the following binding constraints:

1) Cap the total promo exposure to the equivalent of $2,500 list (approx. the token amounts above) and set a hard 60-day usage expiration for the sweetener credits (demo credits may be restricted to 90 days).
2) Allow stacking with LP-202607-BF but only one external voucher per account (no double stacking with other partner promos).
3) Conversion eligibility: accept BrightForge's request for a 45-day conversion trigger, but only if we insert a short addendum stating that any unused promo credits are forfeited on conversion (to avoid double-counting revenue/credits).
4) Priyom: tag promo in billing as "founder_sweetener_Q3_2026" and create a separate ledger entry for recognition; invoice/commit conversion path needs legal sign-off.

Laura — please prepare the minimal addendum with the forfeiture clause and a line about voucher stacking. Priyom — please confirm accounting map and whether we need to run this past finance ops for the ledger treatment.

Aditya — once legal/accounting confirm, send the final RFQ and MSA addendum to Anna and finalize activation timing.

Ben Carter
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
